workouts.title: Toes to Bar - Retest Week
workouts.description:
Toes to Bar - Retest Week
Strict Hanging Knee to Elbows 2x8-10
*Think about compressing your belly button and chest together here, and curl your hips under you.
The goal is to gain control through your core while hanging from the bar.
Kipping Knee to Elbows 2x10
*Drive the knees all the way to elbows. This is the same motion as the strict knees to elbows, but now you are being dynamic and using a kip to work through the same range of motion.
AMRAP 5
Max Rep Toes to Bar
NOTES:
- This test was performed on week one of the program. If you have not done it yet, then today will be your baseline. For those that have done the test, look back at your first score and see how you broke up the sets. Try to do better this week!

workouts.title: Strict Press

Strict Press

NOTES:
- This week you will build to a MAX set of 5 strict press. The rep range is 3-5 because you should be going for it and three reps is the minimum.
- Take at least five sets to build to your max.
- Rest at least 2:00 between sets.
